article.title: Proceratium silaceum
article.extract: Proceratium silaceum is a species of ant in the family Formicidae.

turns.explainer_raw:
Start with the basics: it's an ant species. Proceratium are cryptic ants that eat spider eggs, and this one lives in eastern North America.
